name: What is the typical timeframe for a new flooring installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a new flooring installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a new flooring installation depends on several factors, including the type of flooring, the size of the area, and the condition of the subfloor. For smaller projects like a single room with basic LVP or laminate, installation might take 1-3 days. Larger projects involving multiple rooms, complex patterns, or materials like hardwood or tile that require acclimatization or extensive subfloor prep could take 3-7 days or even longer. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing the scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: New flooring installation typically takes 1-7 days, depending on project size, flooring type, and subfloor conditions. Smaller projects are quicker.
